_comment: Apps quit gracefully on `aimode on` to free RAM. Derived from the machine audit. Edit ~/.aimode/config/services.json to taste. Names are macOS application names (as shown in Activity Monitor / System Events).
_launchd_comment: User LaunchAgents to disable for the duration of AI Mode, re-enabled on `off`. Empty by default — nothing is touched until you opt in.
_never_comment: Safety net. If any resolved target matches one of these substrings (case-insensitive), aimode refuses to stop it. Protects SSH, the graphics stack, power, audio, remote-access tools and the terminal aimode runs in.
